summary: The Securing Tech and Election Administration Defenses For All States and Territories Act (STEADFAST Act) ends the public financing program for presidential election campaigns and nominating conventions. It replaces it with an Election Security Fund, which provides grants to states and U.S. territories for improving election system security, updating voting equipment, and protecting paper ballots.

affected_groups.effect: Receive federal grant money for election security, voting equipment, and cybersecurity, provided they meet specific eligibility and priority criteria.
Lose access to public campaign financing and primary matching funds.
Can continue to designate a portion of their income tax payments, which will now go to the Election Security Fund instead of the presidential campaign fund.
Affected by state-level security updates, voting equipment replacements, and potential requirements for photo identification and paper ballots to qualify states for priority funding.

key_provisions: Terminates the Presidential Election Campaign Fund and the Presidential Primary Matching Payment Account.
Establishes a new Election Security Fund financed by taxpayer designations on income tax returns and transfers remaining money from the old presidential funds.
Directs the Election Assistance Commission to distribute grants to eligible states based on their proportion of registered voters.
Requires eligible states to certify they do not permit noncitizens to vote in any public elections to receive funding.
Prioritizes grant distribution to states that use verifiable paper ballots, utilize verification programs to prevent noncitizen voter registration, and require valid photo identification to vote.
Prohibits states from using grant funds for litigation, judgments, or general election administrator training unrelated to equipment use.
missing_information: The exact dollar amounts that will be available in the Election Security Fund or transferred from the terminated presidential funds.
The precise timeline for when the grant payments will begin other than general reporting and vendor publication deadlines.
summary_detail.plain_summary: The Securing Tech and Election Administration Defenses For All States and Territories Act (STEADFAST Act) ends the public financing program for presidential election campaigns and nominating conventions. It replaces it with an Election Security Fund, which provides grants to states and U.S. territories for improving election system security, updating voting equipment, and protecting paper ballots.
summary_detail.significance: This bill shifts federal election-related funding priorities away from paying for presidential campaigns and toward upgrading the physical and cyber security infrastructure of state and territorial voting systems.

title: STEADFAST Act
